mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a room addition in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, building permits are almost always required for room additions in Berkeley, Oakland, and other East Bay cities. These permits ensure that the construction complies with local building codes, zoning regulations, and safety standards. Our team can assist with navigating the permitting process, preparing necessary documentation, and submitting plans to the relevant city departments.
